title: Unit 1 · Orientation — All Nine at Once
description: Poe, "The Cask of Amontillado": four short sentences containing all nine parts of speech.

annotations.label: noun
annotations.note: Motley is the patched costume of a jester — here it is a thing, so it is a noun.

sentences.text: The wine sparkled in his eyes and the bells jingled.

annotations.label: preposition
annotations.note: "In" shows a relationship of place, so it is a preposition.

annotations.label: adjective
annotations.note: "His" sits in front of a noun and describes it, so it works as an adjective here.

annotations.label: conjunction
annotations.note: "And" joins two complete ideas, so it is a conjunction.

annotations.label: pronoun
annotations.note: "It" stands in for a thing already named, so it is a pronoun.

annotations.label: adverb
annotations.note: "Very" modifies the adjective "damp" — an adverb can modify more than a verb.

annotations.label: interjection
annotations.note: An interjection expresses sudden feeling and stands outside the sentence's structure.
